name: ph-company-formation
description: Philippine company formation and entity choice for 2026. Distinguishes a domestic stock corporation, One Person Corporation, partnership, sole proprietorship and foreign-company branch or representative office. Covers incorporators, capital, the Foreign Investments Act domestic-market exceptions, SEC and DTI registration, BIR books and tax registration, local permits, employer registrations, and the separate SEC and BIR annual reporting and audit tests. Use for a founder deciding how to register, a foreign investor testing capital requirements, or an existing corporation increasing capital. Does not treat a statutory capital floor as the total startup budget or promise an agency processing time.
